data.name: searchAndFilters_text
data.value: In the Diagnostics pane, type TOUR001 into the search box, narrow the list with the filter popup, and clear the “Document” checkbox.

data.name: fixList_text
data.value: On the Diagnostics tab, press Show/Hide diagnostics to show every pane, then open the Fix list tab and select the applied fix.

data.name: selectVisualizationUnavailableStep_text
data.value: Visualize differently — this finding has only one option

data.name: navigateFindings_text
data.value: At the top of the Warnings pane, use the previous and next arrows to move to a neighbouring TOUR001 finding. The counter between the arrows shows the position, such as 3 / 47.

data.name: openDocument_text
data.value: On the Revit Home page, select Open and choose a project or family.

data.name: openTutorialSample_text
data.value: If the sample did not open automatically, on the Revit ribbon select Diagnostics → Open tutorial.

data.name: openConfigurationFolder_text
data.value: Every check is a YAML file you can copy and adapt. In the TOUR001 row, press the document button to see its rule.

data.name: selectDiagnostic_text
data.value: At the top of the Diagnostics pane, enable TOUR001 “Practical tour: review a model element”. Only actions with this check advance the tour.

data.name: runDiagnostics_text
data.value: At the top of the Diagnostics pane, select Run diagnostics with TOUR001 enabled.

data.name: inspectFinding_text
data.value: In the Warnings pane, select a TOUR001 finding and review its message and affected element.

data.name: showElement_text
data.value: In the selected TOUR001 row, select Show to open the visualization menu and choose any option to locate the element in the model.

data.name: selectVisualization_text
data.value: In the same TOUR001 row, open the Show menu again and choose “Inspect closely: color, crop, focus”.

data.name: understandFix_text
data.value: In the TOUR001 row, open the lightbulb menu and apply the fix.

data.name: exportReport_text
data.value: At the top right of the Warnings pane, select Export report and choose a format.

data.name: exportReportAnotherFormat_text
data.value: Export the report once more, this time choosing a different format — for example, HTML after CSV.

data.name: cleanRunExportReport_text
data.value: No findings were found — that is a successful result. Export is at the top right of the Warnings pane.
